{{Quote|We regret to inform you that your family member, Cal Handro, has been declared missing. At this time, we attepmting to clarify his status. One of our operatives in Bestine is looking into the matter and has recently uncovered some interesting information.|Sergeant Vekker, to the family of Cal Handro|<ref name="SWG:P14" />}}
'''Vekker''' was a member of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Vekker was serving under the orders of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jevan Monsul]] who was based in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:P14" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lieutenant Monsul was leading the investigation about the disappearance of [[Cal Handro]],<ref name="SWG:P14" /> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] involved in [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Getting closer?"</ref> as well as in [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trafficking for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> Handro was wanted by the Empire but he had disappeared after his ship crashed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "Man Down!"</ref> Sergeant Vekker contacted the family of [[Cal Handro]] to notify the disappearance of the pilot and urge the family to cooperate fully in Lieutenant Monsul's investigation.<ref name="SWG:P14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Vekker was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P14" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]," on [[March 9]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> Sergeant Vekker was mentioned in the main loading screen styled as a in-universe communication that introduced the first chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline.<ref name="SWG:P14" />
